kind: local checks after streaming adoption verification; no deployment, no host access

commands.command: RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 cargo test --locked --profile release-fast -p enhance-pir-server --test rpc
commands.note: run on the tree one clippy-only edit before the source revision (is_multiple_of in store.rs)

commands.command: cargo test --locked --profile release-fast -p enhance-pir-server --lib adoption_streams -- --ignored --nocapture (3 runs)

adoption_measurement.workload: synthetic journals: 700,000 records of 653 bytes (457,100,000 bytes each) in 50,000 blocks; half the staged records gain a fee
adoption_measurement.method: /proc/self/clear_refs reset, VmHWM minus VmRSS before adopt_staged
adoption_measurement.page_cache: warm; files written immediately before; cold-cache time not measured
